promptIMG.introduction: I first made these keto pumpkin cream cheese muffins a few years ago when I was craving all the cozy fall flavors but needed to keep my carbs low. I remember trying a few recipes that ended up dry or crumbly, which was so disappointing. After some experimenting, I discovered that adding a rich cream cheese swirl right in the center not only adds moisture but also creates this delightful cheesecake surprise in every bite. What sets this recipe apart is balancing almond and coconut flours with warm spices and the perfect amount of pumpkin puree to keep the muffins tender and flavorful. Plus, using erythritol keeps it keto-friendly without that weird aftertaste. I love how these muffins come out golden with a slightly caramelized crust but stay soft inside. They’re great for breakfast, a snack, or even a little dessert. The cream cheese swirl melts just enough during baking to give that luscious, creamy texture that feels indulgent but is still low-carb. It’s become a favorite in my family, especially on chilly autumn mornings when you want something comforting but simple. You'll love how easy they are to make and how perfectly they capture pumpkin season without any guilt.
